page.overview:
Who is Arnold?

Arnold the Pygmy Puff is the pet of Ginny Weasley, who appears in LEGO Harry Potter: Years 5-7. Since it is a pet, it can be sent into tubes.

In August 1996, Ginny Weasley bought Arnold the Pygmy Puff from her brothers, Fred and George Weasley from their shop, Weasley's Wizard Wheezes. Arnold enjoyed playing in front of the fireplace in the Gryffindor common room at Hogwarts, and sitting on Ginny's shoulder, where it often attracted the attention of Crookshanks, Hermione Granger's cat.
